title: Faltings annihilator theorem for local cohomology
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a global annihilator by a double induction on cohomological degree and dimension-function strata. Spectral-sequence filtrations control successive powers of annihilators, and finite dualizing Ext supports produce uniform choices. The converse locates a minimal failing depth-codimension pair and proves its local cohomology cannot be annihilated.
